svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"nametape-cloth-blank-ultramarine","name":"Blank cloth last-name tape, ultramarine","size_in":{"w":5.25,"h":1},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,525,100],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"5 1/4 x 1 in: the tape loops of the OCP/utility uniform (GL/PD 14-04B, as modelled in garment-ocp-coat-abu-cut name_tape / cap_tape landmarks); CAPR 39-1 7.1.1.2.3 says only that the tape matches the hook panel length. Colours: Fig A6-3 (figure shows bright ultramarine and a teal-leaning dark blue).","provenance":"in-house construction; shape, merrowed edge and stitch line only, no lettering","colours":{"cloth":"#0b3fa6","edge":"#082c78","stitch":"#5f86d6"},"cloth_color":{"hex":"#0b3fa6","note":"ultramarine blue (to be phased out 15 June 2021, 10.9.8-9)"},"anchors":{"top_center":[262.5,0],"bottom_center":[262.5,100],"center":[262.5,50],"left_edge":[0,50],"right_edge":[525,50],"text_center":[262.5,50]},"landmarks":{"tape":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":525,"h":100},"text_zone":{"x":18,"y":14.000000000000002,"w":488.99999999999994,"h":72}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); text_zone is where the white (ultramarine) or silver (dark blue) lettering goes, centred, letter height up to 0.72 in","text":{"content":"member's legal last name (diacritics and hyphens allowed, all letters one height)","colour":"white","case":"upper","align":"center","max_height_in":0.72},"fastener":"sew-on or hook-and-loop (Velcro) back; tapes and rank must be all sewn or all Velcro (7.1.1.1)","documented":["name tape right chest, CAP tape left chest on the uniforms that take them (7.1.1.2.3, 5.1.x)","white lettering on ultramarine or silver lettering on dark blue (10.9.8-9)"],"assumed":["5 1/4 x 1 in size","stitch line inset","colours"],"grade":"insignia-plate","fit":{"method":"n/a","score":null}}
